verdict: Ferguson's sales rose 4.6% to $8.8 billion as non-residential work grew 8%, and reported operating profit rose 6.1% to $893 million despite a small dip in gross margin.

segments.name: United States
segments.note: The US distribution business — plumbing, HVAC, waterworks and more for pro contractors. Non-residential sales rose 8%; residential rose 2%.

segments.name: Canada
segments.note: The Canadian business — sales fell 1.9% as a non-core divestment offset 1.7% organic growth in a tough residential market.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Branch and delivery staff, sales and the back office — the cost of running about 1,700 locations.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Wear-and-tear on buildings, trucks and systems, plus amortization of acquired intangibles.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: Small corporate restructuring costs tied to establishing the US parent company.

otherDetail: Net interest expense of $52M, partly offset by $5M of other income — a net $47M cost below operating profit.

takeaways.title: Non-residential carried growth
takeaways.text: US non-residential revenue rose 8% on large capital projects, while residential — about half of sales — returned to growth at +2% despite weak housing activity.

takeaways.title: Gross margin eased a touch
takeaways.text: Gross margin was 31.0%, down 20 basis points, because last year was flattered by the timing of supplier price increases. Operating leverage still lifted reported operating margin to 10.2%.

takeaways.title: Buying growth, and guiding higher
takeaways.text: Ferguson closed five acquisitions in the quarter and agreed to buy FloWorks; full-year calendar 2026 guidance was raised to mid-single-digit sales growth.

oneTimers: Adjusted figures exclude $37M of amortization of acquired intangibles and $2M of corporate restructuring costs; adjusted operating profit was $932M and adjusted EPS $3.39.

Ferguson changed its fiscal year-end from July 31 to December 31, so this is the second quarter of calendar 2026 — results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 were scheduled for November 9, 2026, after this report's cutoff.

sources.label: Official earnings release (SEC EDGAR Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

footerNote: Ferguson now reports on a calendar year (year-end moved from July 31 to December 31 after a five-month transition period in late 2025), so its own naming for this quarter is simply the second quarter of 2026.
